TotalPortfolioValue.name: Total Portfolio Value
TotalPortfolioValue.definition: Total value of the portfolio (sum of the assets, liabilities and unrealised gain/loss) calculated according to the accounting rules.

PreviousTotalPortfolioValue.name: Previous Total Portfolio Value
PreviousTotalPortfolioValue.definition: Previous total value of the portfolio.

TotalPortfolioValueChange.name: Total Portfolio Value Change
TotalPortfolioValueChange.definition: Difference or change between the previous total portfolio value and the current total portfolio value.

TotalBookValue.name: Total Book Value
TotalBookValue.definition: Net asset on balance sheet - total portfolio value minus or plus the unrealised gain or loss.

PreviousTotalBookValue.name: Previous Total Book Value
PreviousTotalBookValue.definition: Previous net asset on balance sheet.

TotalBookValueChange.name: Total Book Value Change
TotalBookValueChange.definition: Difference or change between the previous net asset on balance sheet and the current net asset on balance sheet.

TotalReceipts.name: Total Receipts
TotalReceipts.definition: Total receipts attributable to the portfolio.

TotalDisbursements.name: Total Disbursements
TotalDisbursements.definition: Total disbursements attributable to the portfolio.

UnrealisedGainOrLoss.name: Unrealised Gain Or Loss
UnrealisedGainOrLoss.definition: Difference between the holding value and the book value of the portfolio.

RealisedGainOrLoss.name: Realised Gain Or Loss
RealisedGainOrLoss.definition: Difference between the realised value caused by the actual trade/re-evaluation and the book value of the portfolio.

InvestmentFundDetails.name: Investment Fund Details
InvestmentFundDetails.definition: Valuation information of the investment fund or investment fund share class.
